Title: Does Eurayle's special cost her blood while targeting Hazimel?

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Hello!

I just want to be sure: Are Eurayle's special text and Renewed Vigour  actions while targeting Hazimel, controlled by me? It doesn't spesify they're  actions, but they do target him alright.

Refrences:

Eurayle Gelasia Mylonas
:SAL:
Independent: Eurayle may untap any minion as an action. If you control the minion, this is a +2 stealth action. Scarce.

Hazimel
:RAV:
Independent: Hazimel has 2 votes (titled). Non-Ravnos vampires must burn 2 blood to attempt a  action that targets Hazimel or a card or counter on him. +1 bleed.

Renewed Vigor
+1 stealth action.
[for] Put this card on this acting vampire. During your untap phase, if this vampire is in torpor, you can burn this card to move him or her to your ready region. A vampire can have only one Renewed Vigor.
[obe] Move a vampire in torpor to his controller's ready region, or restore an ally or retainer to his or her starting life (with life counters from the blood bank).
[OBE] Choose any other vampire. That vampire gains enough blood from the blood bank to reach full capacity.

Krausedit\\

Also, if Eurayle uses her special to untap a vampire in, say, cross table, is it a  action towards that metusalah (blockable only by him) or an undirected action (blockable by my predator and prey) at no stealth?

[Gehenna:U]
Cardtype: Vampire

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Mylan's action is non-d when it targets your vampires, thus Mylan has never suffered from Hazimel's special either. And on top of that Mylan is not even a vampire or a vampire controlled by another Methuselah. Hazimel's ability kicks in only and only when a VAMPIRE is performing an action, that vampire is NOT CONTROLLED by Hazimel's owner and that vampire IS NOT RAVNOS. Only if all the three conditions are fulfilled, only then does Hazimel's special make it cost more.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Answers given previously - Eurayle's Renewed Vigor on your own Hazimel is non-D, and is also not affected by Hazimel's cardtext - are valid.
